assertions.text: Installed Agy1.2.4 retains an earlier HTTP429 error in a result after successful model output. Latest-step checking distinguishes this from unresolved rate limiting at print timeout.

Classify the known native result as rate_limit only when the latest matching-conversation step is DONE/error_message. Preserve explicit recovery and cleanup. Do not claim subscription exhaustion or classify text mentions.
